attackers_goals: Use an account that was possibly compromised in the past to gain access to the network and access privileged resources.
description: A service account attempted to log in to a VPN service.
investigative_actions: See whether the service authentication was successful. Check whether the account has done any administrative actions it should not usually do. Look for more logins and authentications by the account throughout the network.
name: VPN login by a service account

variations.name: Rare VPN login by an administrative service account
variations.description: An administrative service account attempted to log in to a VPN service.
